name: CorrectedQtInterval
title: Rate-corrected QT interval (QTc)
description: Computes the heart-rate-corrected QT interval from an ECG and whether it is prolonged.

parameter.name: heart-rate
parameter.documentation: Heart rate at the time of the recording, in beats per minute.

parameter.name: sex
parameter.documentation: Sex of the patient; selects the prolongation threshold. If left out, the higher (female) threshold is used.

parameter.name: ecg-date
parameter.documentation: Date the ECG was recorded; checked only, it does not enter the computation.

parameter.name: qtc
parameter.documentation: Rate-corrected QT interval in ms, 1 decimal.

parameter.name: qtc-prolonged
parameter.documentation: True when QTc exceeds the sex-specific threshold.
